crossRefs.note: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites…
and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and…
Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed Levites and priests, and of the heads of the fathers’ households of Israel…

people.name: Chenaniah
people.line: Levite leader of singing and administration under David

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Izhar
people.line: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi; father of Korah.

translations.web: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
translations.bsb: From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.
